title: Pure Coach
summary: Coach is a FIRE Beast-Warrior Xyz and Rank-Up archetype centered around Coach Soldier Wolfbark, Coach Captain Bearman, and the Rank 8 draw engine Coach King Giantrainer. Wolfbark revives Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warriors every turn while Bearman shifts all Level 4 Beast-Warriors on the field to Level 8 to overlay into Coach King Giantrainer and CXyz Coach Lord Ultimatrainer.

allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Bear: Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior that searches Fire Formation - Tenki and serves as a prime revival target for Coach Soldier Wolfbark.
allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Gorilla: Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior that pops Spell/Traps and revives via Wolfbark.
allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Dragon: Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior that sets Fire Formation Traps and revives Fire Fists.
allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Rooster: Level 3 FIRE Beast-Warrior that searches Fire Fist monsters and swaps Fire Formations.
allow.Fire Formation - Tenki: Continuous Spell that searches Coach Soldier Wolfbark or any Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior.
allow.Fire Formation - Tensu: Continuous Spell that grants an extra Normal Summon of a Beast-Warrior monster each turn (allowing Bearman to be Normal Summoned alongside Wolfbark).
allow.Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force: Ranks up Rank 8 Coach King Giantrainer into Rank 9 CXyz Coach Lord Ultimatrainer.
allow.Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger Kin: Rank 4 Beast-Warrior Xyz that sets Fire Formation - Tenki or Tensu from the Deck and negates monster effects.
allow.Bujintei Kagutsuchi: Rank 4 Beast-Warrior Xyz that mills 5 cards to load the GY with targets for Coach Soldier Wolfbark.

main: Coach Soldier Wolfbark
Core starter that revives any Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior monster from your GY in Defense Position every turn.
Coach Captain Bearman
Can be Normal Summoned without Tributing as a 1300 ATK Level 8, and changes all Level 4 Beast-Warriors you control to Level 8 for Coach King Giantrainer.
Coach Goblin
Returns a card from hand to the bottom of the Deck during the End Phase to draw 1 card, fixing hands.
Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Bear
Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior target for Wolfbark that destroys an opponent's monster and sets Tenki.
Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Gorilla
Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior target for Wolfbark that destroys an opponent's Spell/Trap.
Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Dragon
Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior that sets Fire Formation Traps from the Deck.
Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Rooster
Special Summoned via Fire Fist monsters to search another Beast-Warrior.
Fire Formation - Tenki
Searches Coach Soldier Wolfbark, Bear, or Gorilla on activation.
Fire Formation - Tensu
Grants an additional Beast-Warrior Normal Summon each turn so you can summon Wolfbark and Bearman in the same turn.
Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force
Upgrades Coach King Giantrainer into CXyz Coach Lord Ultimatrainer after Giantrainer uses all 3 of its draw materials.
extra: Signature Rank 8 Xyz boss that detaches up to 3 materials per turn to draw up to 3 cards and burn the opponent for 800 per monster drawn.
Signature Rank 9 Chaos Xyz boss that cannot be targeted by card effects and detaches 1 material to draw 1 card and burn for 800.
Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King
Rank 4 Xyz made via Wolfbark that sets Tenki or Tensu directly from the Deck.
Rank 4 Xyz that mills 5 cards to ensure Wolfbark has a Level 4 FIRE Beast-Warrior in the GY.
